- Discussed diversity in festivals, food, dress, language and regional traditions.

end.parentNote: Riya practised giving regional examples and finding common ideas beneath different celebrations and traditions. They correctly connected Lohri, Pongal and Makar Sankranti with harvest celebrations, and explained that shared seasonal ideas can have different customs. The lesson ended before the teach-back was completed; at home, ask Riya to make a two-column list of one shared idea and two different regional forms.
